subject: english-language
sourceName: WJEC Eduqas GCE A Level English Language specification (from 2015)

subs: Section A: Analysis of Spoken Language — compulsory question analysing at least two transcripts
Section B: Language Issues — one essay from a choice of three on: Standard and Non-Standard English; language and power; language and situation; language acquisition
Section A: Language Change Over Time — three texts (none earlier than 1500); archaic-features question plus essay analysing language change
Section B: English in the Twenty-First Century — data-based question on distinctively 21st-century language use

units.n: 3. Component 3 — Creative and Critical Use of Language
subs: One question from a choice of two, each with a stimulus text
Two original writing responses plus one commentary on one of the produced texts
Language investigation (2500–3500 words) on the theme of language and identity
Choose one area: language and self-representation; language and gender; language and culture; or language diversity
